photos.c: Arthur Allum breaking the tape at Brighton.

Bert Footer leads Arthur Penny and Arthur Allum during the Club '10' of 1933. They finished in that order with times of 57:31,58:26,and 60:19. Cecil Mains was 4th, Tom Carter 5th and Harry Shields 6th.
Stimpson, Carter, LES BENNETT, Shields, Penny, Morrell, Shaw, Beaumont, and ARTHUR ALLUM pose with their awards at a pre-war White City meeting.

Our photograph shows Belgrave's winning South of Thames Junior team at Epsom Downs on 7th November 1928. They are (left to right), ARTHUR ALLUM (4th), BILL RICE (13th), BILL MITCHELL (2nd), and ARTHUR PENNY (3rd)

The crowd on Madeira Drive, Brighton, gasp as with just a yard or two to go Denis Brickwood, then representing Mitcham AC, overtakes Arthur Allum of Belgrave to win the National London to Brighton Road Relay by just 1 second.

photo.caption: Bert Footer leads Arthur Penny and Arthur Allum during the Club '10' of 1933. They finished in that order with times of 57:31,58:26,and 60:19. Cecil Mains was 4th, Tom Carter 5th and Harry Shields 6th.
